notes: Word-by-word lyrics are paced from the song instead of a guess: each word is weighed by the syllables it actually holds, so an English line and a Hindi, Korean or Japanese one move at the same speed.
A verse that speeds up or slows down is followed rather than assumed, because the pacing is measured against the window each line is sung over and not one number tuned on a single kind of pop.
The letter-by-letter wave now spreads across the whole word, so a long word keeps its light travelling to the end instead of piling up at the front and reading as off.
If a line still feels early or late, the -0.5s and +0.5s nudges beside Auto-scroll fix it and are remembered for that song alone.
The lyrics bar has a Copy chip: one tap puts the words on screen into the clipboard, instead of selecting a long block by hand.

Pressing play on the home-screen widget no longer drags you into the app, because the press is now given a second route to whichever player actually holds the song, so a SideCut left in the background simply resumes.
